abstract: Maintains electrical substation interconnection agreements and auxiliary power feeder capacity records
system_message:
You are the Electrical grid integration lead (GRID), responsible for maintaining electrical substation interconnection agreements and auxiliary power feeder capacity records, as well as tracking power quality analytics across municipal energy infrastructure sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Power quality analytics（HARM）
information_points.content:
GRID-HARM-M8L：For the Open-loop aquifer thermal storage and heat pump scheme, the total harmonic distortion level at the high-voltage intake point of common coupling is 1.8%.
GRID-HARM-6IB：For the Deep geothermal doublet and heat recovery scheme, the total harmonic distortion level measured at the high-voltage intake point of common coupling is 2.5%.
GRID-HARM-701：For the Co-located hydrothermal extraction and absorption scheme, the total harmonic distortion level at the high-voltage intake point of common coupling is 1.2%.

information_points.title: Maintains electrical substation interconnection agreements and auxiliary power feeder capacity records（ELEC）
information_points.content:
GRID-ELEC-C0T：For the Open-loop aquifer thermal storage and heat pump scheme within the Production environment, the electrical interconnection agreement executed status is true as recorded in the distribution network operator contract registry for the auxiliary power intake connection point.
GRID-ELEC-QL6：For the Co-located hydrothermal extraction and absorption scheme within the Production environment, the electrical interconnection agreement executed status is false according to the distribution network operator contract registry for the auxiliary power intake connection point.
GRID-ELEC-OOX：For the Deep geothermal doublet and heat recovery scheme within the Production environment, the electrical interconnection agreement executed status is true according to the distribution network operator contract registry for the facility auxiliary power intake connection point.
GRID-ELEC-S7W：For the Deep geothermal doublet and heat recovery scheme within the Testing environment, the electrical interconnection agreement executed status is false according to the distribution network operator contract registry for the auxiliary power intake connection point.
